question: Does the existing ARTEMIS Temporal Map remain understandable and useful when the reviewed Leonardo major-life package is rendered across 1452–1519?

coverage.absence_semantics: Missing Presence data never means historical absence.

ux_contract.progressive_refinement: Show six major periods first, then let the user inspect the eleven source-bound Presence anchors.
ux_contract.range: A two-handle calendar interval includes every Presence whose temporal extent overlaps the selected years.
ux_contract.scrub: A chosen build origin plus one current-year cursor progressively reveals Presence anchors reached by that year.
ux_contract.selection: Single click opens a compact popup without moving the camera; another explicit action opens the right drawer; double click focuses the map.
ux_contract.routes: Dashed straight connectors show chronological order only, not known travel routes. Historical route geometry remains null where unsupported.

non_goals: No new historical or biographical claims
No continuous-position claim for residence ranges
No live source federation, generic ingestion, backend or storage
